source_caption_text:
Never forget when 50 Cent started trolling with “Prop Money” after he filed for bankruptcy in 2015 😭😂

Who remembers when 50 Cent filed for bankruptcy in 2015 and still found a way to turn the situation into Instagram content 😭💵

After filing that July, 50 began sharing photos of himself surrounded by stacks of cash. In one post, he arranged the bills to spell out “BROKE.” In another, he lay on a bed covered in money while joking about finding something to watch on TV. Even while his finances were making headlines, his sense of humor was very much intact.

But those posts eventually attracted attention beyond his followers. By early 2016, the photos had become an issue in his bankruptcy proceedings, with Judge Ann Nevins questioning whether they pointed to assets that hadn’t been disclosed. What looked like another round of internet trolling became something he had to explain to the court.

50’s explanation was that the photos used prop money. In a court filing, he said the images were part of maintaining his public persona and marketing his businesses. He also explained that appearing beside cash, expensive cars or jewelry in a photograph didn’t necessarily mean he owned everything pictured.
